resources.string: Close interrupted photo or camera interactions without restoring access.
Open system photo picker or camera
The selected JPEG or PNG is being validated for temporary read access by the verified app.

Photo unavailable, cancelled, expired, too large or unsupported. Only JPEG/PNG up to 8 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 12 megapixels are accepted. Cameras requiring seekable files or reopening output are unsupported. No thumbnail fallback is used. Streaming photo providers require Android 11 or newer.

Android handles photo selection or capture. The validated photo is automatically returned to the verified app. With Ask, this review approves the flow once; Android permissions still apply. Selection may use a cloud provider. Original image metadata, potentially including location, is retained. Jarvys does not save to the gallery; the external camera may keep its own copy. Access is temporary and cancellation does not recall copies. An interrupted operation has an unknown outcome; recovery does not prove the external picker or camera closed.
